title: The Portal
after: You spin around and get a really good view out the windows. “Are those stars…where the heck did I end up…is this a spaceship?” you say as you look out at the vastness of space and stars.
alt: The fully covered explorer lands in a metal corridor and looks out at the stars through a wide window.

title: The Bridge
after: All of them are dressed the same, in loose-fitting grey jumpsuits with zippers down the middle and patches everywhere.
alt: Captain Aster, Percy at the flight controls, and Trace gather on the ship’s bridge in patched gray jumpsuits.

title: Permission to Come Aboard
after: You put it on right there, over your clothes. Did I mention it’s about three sizes too big? It’s about three sizes too big. You have to roll the sleeves up four times.
alt: The explorer tries on an oversized crew jumpsuit while Captain Aster, Percy, and Trace look on.

title: The Engine Room
after: You sit down on the floor beside him with your notebook, and for a while the two of you just watch the light. You draw it. Bright, dim. Bright, dim.
alt: The explorer sketches the blue power core beside Trace while a small solar-panel maintenance robot carries an oil can.
